name: badge
title: Badge
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Badge in lettering type. Variants: default (ink flat), outline, tone (screentone tab at the start, label on paper), destructive (clean accent flat), burst ("NEW!" star) and stamp (tilted accent stamp). Optional square status dot; icons via data-icon.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/badge". It wraps your own components/ui/badge, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Ink, outline, burst and a tilted stamp.
meta.usage:
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/manga/badge"

<Badge variant="burst">New!</Badge>
<Badge variant="outline" dot>Live</Badge>

props.name: dot
props.description: Square status dot before the label.
